scope: External software benchmarks; not HILO runs or WANTED scores.

benchmarks.name: ProgramBench
benchmarks.headline: Build the program. Not just a patch.
benchmarks.description: Reconstruct a working codebase from an executable and documentation, then compare its behavior with the reference.
benchmarks.metric_explanation: A program is resolved only when every hidden behavior test for that task passes. Average test pass rate is a separate diagnostic.
benchmarks.tool_policy: No original source, internet, decompiler or disassembler; the reference binary is execute-only.
benchmarks.robotics_application: HILO engineering example: reproduce a legacy command-line utility before replacing a robot integration dependency.

publisher_observation.note: The retrieved publisher table is dated September 9 and differs from the submitted snapshot. The selected rows below are not a current-model ranking; missing models are not assigned zero.

submitted_snapshot.metric: Submitted percentage; run configuration not supplied

benchmarks.name: SRE-Bench
benchmarks.headline: Recover what a binary does.
benchmarks.description: Analyze software without its source and answer verifiable questions about its behavior. Here SRE refers to reverse engineering, not site reliability operations.
benchmarks.metric_explanation: Capability counts completed individual tasks; fully solved requires all six tasks for an instance. These percentages are not interchangeable.
benchmarks.tool_policy: A sandboxed reverse-engineering toolkit includes decompilers, disassemblers and debuggers. Do not apply ProgramBench's tool ban here.
benchmarks.robotics_application: HILO engineering example: inspect authorized firmware or a binary-only component to document its interface and failure behavior.

publisher_observation.note: The publisher methodology was checked. The three submitted percentages were not confirmed in the retrieved page text, and their metric selection was not provided. No replacement scores are invented.
publisher_observation.metric: Metric must be specified before comparison

submitted_snapshot.metric: Submitted percentage; capability vs fully solved unspecified

benchmarks.name: Code Migration
benchmarks.headline: Change the language. Keep the behavior.
benchmarks.description: Port a working source program into a target language and evaluate the rebuilt program against hidden behavior tests.
benchmarks.metric_explanation: The overall score weights source repositories equally. Code quality is separate; passing some tests does not mean the whole migration is complete.
benchmarks.tool_policy: Offline sandbox with source and instructions; submit a target-language implementation and Dockerfile. Wrappers and copied reference artifacts are disallowed.
benchmarks.robotics_application: HILO engineering example: port a simulator adapter or telemetry utility while checking edge cases against a frozen regression suite.
